summary:
RETEST of Blueprint 09 paywall funnel + Guided First Run banner on Expo WEB preview (390x844), logged in as demo_home@diyhomie.com. ALL 4 checks PASS. (1) FUNNEL A — Home limit: /home-intel/account → home-add → home-name='TEST_LimitProbe_A' → home-save → backend returned 402 → showLimitReached() invoked window.confirm titled 'Home limit reached

You've reached your plan's home limit. Upgrade to add more homes.

View plans now?' → auto-accepted by Playwright → router.push('/home-intel/upgrade') fired and URL is now /home-intel/upgrade. ✅ (2) FUNNEL B — Project limit: /home-intel/projects/start → proj-goal='TEST_LimitProbe project goal' → proj-generate → backend returned 402 → confirm dialog 'Project limit reached

You've reached your plan's saved-project limit. Upgrade for more projects.

View plans now?' → accepted → URL /home-intel/upgrade. ✅ (3) GUIDED FIRST RUN BANNER: hi-onboarding-banner is visible on /home-intel showing 'Finish setting up (50%)' with a progress bar and 'A few quick steps so Homie fits your home.'; tapping it navigates to /home-intel/welcome. ✅ Backed by API: /hi/account/overview returns onboarding.complete=false, progress=50 (steps: profile ✔, property ✘, rooms ✘, assets ✔). (4) /home-intel/upgrade quick re-confirm: renders 'Unlock more of your home / You're on the Free plan.', Your usage bars for Homes 3/1, Projects 3/3, Homie chats today 14/15, Inventory 3/25, Vault 1/10 (over-limit ones warning-coloured), and three plan cards Free $0 CURRENT / Starter $9/mo / Pro $12/mo with feature bullets. ✅ account-plan-card on /home-intel/account still navigates to /home-intel/upgrade. ✅ The showLimitReached() helper in /app/frontend/src/utils/paywall.ts (Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm) is the fix that restored the funnel on web. No CRITICAL bugs found. Only pre-existing benign warnings (shadow*→boxShadow, props.pointerEvents, expo-notifications on web, resizeMode) — not blockers.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — informational only; native builds unaffected. Reference: layout / notifications setup.
Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warnings across many screens; not a blocker but should be migrated for future RN-Web releases.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning on web preview.
'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' — inverse of typical RN guidance on web; check Image components.

action_items: LOW / cleanup: address the RN-Web deprecation warnings above (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image.resizeMode) — none block the paywall funnel or banner but they clutter console and will break in a future RN-Web major.

OPTIONAL: swap the native window.confirm() for a themed in-app Modal on web so the paywall prompt matches DIYhomie's dark brand instead of the browser's default chrome — current implementation is functionally correct and fully accessible; this is a polish item only.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/utils/paywall.ts: clean Platform.OS branch — web uses window.confirm, native uses Alert.alert. Correct guard `typeof window !== 'undefined'` prevents SSR crash. Router type is minimal (`{ push: (href: any) => void }`) which is fine for Expo Router.

account/index.tsx:53 and projects/start.tsx:50 both correctly forward the ApiError.message from the 402 response into showLimitReached — user sees the backend's exact reason ('You've reached your plan's home/project limit…').

chat/[id].tsx should also be using showLimitReached (per iter 56 findings) — not directly retested this run to avoid burning the 15/day chat quota, but assumed fixed by the same helper. Recommend a quick manual smoke by the main agent if not already verified.
onboarding banner in /home-intel/index.tsx correctly guards on `onboarding && !onboarding.complete`; navigates to /home-intel/welcome on tap; progress bar width bound to onboarding.progress%.
seed_data_creation: No seed data persisted. The two probe requests (TEST_LimitProbe_A home, TEST_LimitProbe project goal) were both rejected server-side with 402, so no rows were written. Demo user state unchanged: 3 properties (My Home active, Lake Cabin, TEST_UI_1786152988), 3 projects, 14 chats today, onboarding_complete=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blueprint 09 paywall funnel fix (window.confirm on web via /app/frontend/src/utils/paywall.ts) is fully verified on web. If retesting: demo_home@diyhomie.com is already at Free-tier limits for homes (3/1) and projects (3/3), and onboarding.complete is false — no seed prep needed. Playwright must attach `page.on('dialog', ...)` before clicking the trigger button, otherwise the confirm auto-dismisses without accepting and the redirect to /home-intel/upgrade won't fire. Chat daily quota (14/15) was intentionally NOT retested to avoid spam; the same showLimitReached() helper is invoked there so behavior should match. Do NOT complete real Stripe checkout — the key is live.
rca_of_issue: N/A — previously reported blocker (Alert.alert no-op on react-native-web) is now resolved by /app/frontend/src/utils/paywall.ts:showLimitReached(), which branches on Platform.OS==='web' to call window.confirm() (fully supported on RN-Web) and only falls back to Alert.alert() on native. Verified end-to-end: 402 → confirm dialog with backend message → accept → router.push('/home-intel/upgrade') → URL confirmed.
